description:
The agent joins a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams meeting as a named participant (bot_name, default the agent's name), through the user's Attendee (connect_meeting_integration first). THIS PUTS A BOT INTO A REAL MEETING AND SPENDS CREDIT ONCE IT IS LET IN: confirm with the user before calling it. By default the agent speaks only when someone says its name (respond_when "addressed"); use "always" for a one-to-one meeting. Nothing is charged while the bot joins or waits to be admitted; once in, it is billed like a realtime session until it leaves. Returns the meeting with status joining; poll get_meeting for waiting_room, in_meeting, ended or failed (with error). The transcript is on get_call with the same id.

Requires scope `calls:write`.

bot_name.description: The name shown in the meeting. Defaults to the agent's name.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for safe retries. Generated automatically when omitted. Reuse the SAME value when retrying the SAME logical request; never reuse it for a different one.

lead_id.description: Existing lead to attribute the meeting to.

max_duration_seconds.description: Cap on time in the meeting once admitted. Default 3600.

meeting_url.description: The meeting's join link, e.g. https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij, https://zoom.us/j/123?pwd=…, or a Teams meetup-join link.

metadata.description: Echoed on the call and its callCompleted webhook. Not shown to the model.

respond_when.description: "addressed" (default): speak only after its name is said, and briefly after it last spoke. "always": answer whatever it hears.

signed_in.description: Sign the bot in before it joins (Meet and Teams). Defaults to the integration's signed_in_bots setting; true on Zoom is refused.

waiting_room_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait to be admitted. Default 600.

wake_names.description: Extra names that address the agent, e.g. how people shorten it.

name: join_meeting
title: Send an agent to a meeting
